adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in addGuests.handler.ts line 158, credentials are fetched for ctx.user (the person invoking the API - could be an attendee or team admin) rather than booking.user (the organizer). The code at lines 45-50 explicitly allows non-organizers (team admins and attendees) to call this handler. When eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees is called with these credentials, it will attempt to update the calendar using the wrong user's credentials. The booking's destinationCalendar belongs to the organizer, but the credentials loaded are from whoever invoked the API. This is a real bug that could cause calendar sync failures or updates to the wrong calendar.
